notes.title: You Versus 27 is about to release! (Contain your excitement)
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello, world! :csgoglobe:[/h1][/b]
In preparation for the 'long awaited' release of [i]You Versus 27 Elves[/i], a website has been made to make it easier to share the game around with friends or your friendly neighborhood elf: [b][url=http://27elves.com/]27elves.com[/url][/b] Easy enough to remember, right?

It seemed fitting that this game launch with a discount of, you guessed it, 27%, so if you're not feeling committed to the full price and mystery of this game, grab it while you can.

But mostly importantly, if you're interested in listening to the amazing soundtrack made by [url=https://soundcloud.com/user-768285590]Kampen[/url] anywhere other than the game and want to send some serious love, check the soundtrack out on soundcloud under the name [url=https://soundcloud.com/user-768285590/sets/you-versus-27-elves-ost]You Versus 27 Elves OST[/url]
(The soundtrack can also be played on the [url=http://27elves.com/]27elves.com[/url] website)

We know this game is... Well... Odd. So, whether you love the game, hate the game, or wish you never even saw this game, humor us and drop your unique review.

This project is only the beginning for us- a jumping off point, if you will. So, stay tuned, and again: [i]Your feedback is greatly appreciated![/i]

[b]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your interest/mixed feelings. Best wishes, and Merry Christmas in March. :D:[/b]
